criteria.requirement: Add Logger.silence(level="INFO", *, module=None) using the existing ContextVar compatibility layer. Suppress matching records whose severity is <= threshold before message formatting, with string level or nonbool nonnegative integer; module None covers all, a string covers itself/dot-separated descendants. Scope rules to the same shared Logger core (bound loggers included), combine nested scopes additively and reset on every exit. Preserve global enable/disable and normal sink filters. Async siblings/new threads stay independent while created child tasks inherit context; do not mutate global activation to emulate local silence.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
